tests.scope: Actual LX7 S32I/L32I guest instructions drive GPIO matrix,I2C/RMT/SPI MMIO; checks correct and incorrect routes, absent-address NACK, RTC date rollover/STOP, resets, source-bounded capacities and no inherited display.

limitations: Exact four sensor SKU identities retained; only shared ES8311/ES7210 control ports plus BOOT/PWR implemented. No camera SCCB/DVP, sensor chip ID, capture frame, CH32 IO/power emulation or optional LCD.
A physical TF slot is declared and prepared64MiBFAT32 retained locally; guest native-SD transport is not attached because CH32 mode/power gating has not been implemented.
Plain manufacturer Factory.bin contains all four named camera drivers and is separate from LCD_1_83/2/2_8/3_5 images; original sensor detection/boot behavior remains unverified for each SKU.
Native source-bounded subset only. No original factory boot, browser/WebGL or physical hardware validation claimed.
